# Under the Haik

> Independent web design and starter visual identity for small businesses in Dubai and across the United Arab Emirates, by ken.lou.

The website presents services, package scope, pricing and portfolio case studies. Portfolio concepts, family projects and client work are labelled individually; concept demos do not establish real businesses, sales or client results. Consult the current service pages for package prices, launch offers, exclusions and availability.

Thiziri is a separate daily-adhkar reading project by Under the Haik. It is not a web-design service. Its dedicated guide is linked below. Personal essays and the former journal have been removed from this website.

## Business and contact

- [Homepage](https://underthehaik.com/): Services, current package pricing, selected projects and process.
- [About](https://underthehaik.com/about/): The independent designer and developer behind Under the Haik.
- [Contact](https://underthehaik.com/contact/): Current enquiry options; use only the contact details published here.
- [Privacy](https://underthehaik.com/privacy/): Website privacy information.

## Services

- [Business website design in Dubai](https://underthehaik.com/services/web-design-dubai/): Static business websites, responsive layouts and agreed scope.
- [One-page website design](https://underthehaik.com/services/one-page-website-dubai/): A focused website for a straightforward business offer.
- [Starter visual identity](https://underthehaik.com/services/visual-identity-dubai/): Logo, colour palette, typography and brand-guide scope.
- [Website and branding package](https://underthehaik.com/services/website-branding-package-dubai/): Complete launch package and exclusions.
- [Website care](https://underthehaik.com/services/website-care-uae/): Optional maintenance and content-update arrangements.
- [Website cost guide](https://underthehaik.com/guides/website-cost-dubai/): Package comparisons, domain setup and recurring costs.

## Selected work

- [Noura Beauty House](https://underthehaik.com/work/noura-beauty-house/): Salon website concept.
- [BrightPath Academy](https://underthehaik.com/work/brightpath-academy/): Tutoring website concept.
- [Serena's Sanctuary](https://underthehaik.com/work/serenas-sanctuary/): Health-coaching client website project.
- [Thiziri case study](https://underthehaik.com/work/thiziri/): Personal app and multilingual reading website project.

## Thiziri

- [Thiziri](https://underthehaik.com/thiziri/): Free, ad-free daily adhkar with Arabic readings and English/French meanings.
- [Thiziri guide for agents](https://underthehaik.com/thiziri/llms.txt): Collection pages, language versions, source notes and privacy links.
